title: Are the files all there?
description:
A Win32 + DirectX 11 project needs these Dear ImGui source files: `imgui.cpp`, `imgui_draw.cpp`, `imgui_tables.cpp`, `imgui_widgets.cpp`, `imgui_impl_win32.cpp`, `imgui_impl_dx11.cpp`. Write

```cpp
std::vector<std::string> missingImGuiFiles(const std::vector<std::string>& projectFiles);
```

Project files may include folders (`third_party/imgui/imgui.cpp`, `backends\imgui_impl_dx11.cpp`): only the name after the last `/` or `\` counts, compared without regard to case. Return the missing required names, in the order listed above.
lessonTitle: Setting Up ImGui with Win32 and DirectX 11
